title: Rory and the Starlight Hollow
verses:
The sun drifted down in a blanket of red,
And Rory was ready to trek off to bed.
The forest was quiet and cool in the shade,
As shadows grew long in the dimming parade.

Then Benny walked over with slow, heavy feet,
And Tilly picked berries so cozy and sweet.
High up in the branches, Nia spread out her wings,
To listen to songs that the night-cricket sings.

And Psittaco chirped from a nest in the bark,
While Ricky crept softly into the deep dark.
The moss in the hollow was padded and deep,
A wonderful place for six friends to go sleep.

A warm little breeze whistled low through the trees,
And rustled the clover that brushed at their knees.
The starlight fell down like a silver-white sheet,
And blanketed Rory from nose to his feet.

Then Tilly yawned wide and nestled down low,
While Benny breathed softly, so steady and slow.
And Psittaco curled in a snug little heap,
While Ricky was ready to fall fast asleep.

Now Nia shut both of her eyes in the night,
And Rory felt safe in the soft silver light.
The stars kept their watch as the cozy world slept,
While dreams through the hollow so quietly crept.
